scenes.heading: Package Types
scenes.narration: Maven. Package Types. In this video we review 7 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: Where is the package type configured for an AEM package?
scenes.heading: In the packageType configuration of the filevault-package-maven-plugin
scenes.body: Section 4 says every package must declare a package type, and that the type is set with the packageType configuration of the filevault-package-maven-plugin.

scenes.question: What packageType do code, immutable packages use?
scenes.heading: application

scenes.question: What packageType do container packages use?
scenes.heading: container
scenes.body: The lesson says container packages set packageType to container, and that the all package is a container.

scenes.question: Which statement about the all package is correct?
scenes.heading: The all package is a container package
scenes.body: Section 4 directly states that the all package is a container.

scenes.question: Given a scenario with a container package, what may it hold according to the speech?
scenes.heading: Only OSGi bundles, configurations, and sub packages
scenes.body: The speech says a container may hold only OSGi bundles, configurations, and sub packages, and must not contain regular nodes.

scenes.heading: merge
